title: Ultimate group stay! | 4 Houses, Hot Tubs & Views!
description:
The ultimate Nashville group destination! Four side-by-side luxury homes offering 16 bedrooms, 16 bathrooms, and 4 private rooftops with hot tubs. Perfect for retreats or reunions, this massive compound sleeps 48+ with 11 King suites. 1 Queen Suite and 4 custom bunk rooms. Enjoy 4 designer kitchens and skyline views, all just 5 mins from Broadway and Topgolf. Managed by BetterBNB, your local experts in 5-star Southern hospitality.

The space
Four modern, mirror-image residences side-by-side.

16 Total Bedrooms: 11 private King suites, 1 Queen suite + 4 custom triple-full bunk rooms.

16 Total Bathrooms: Plenty of privacy for every guest.

4 Rooftop Oases: Each home features a private deck with a luxury hot tub and skyline views.

Group Hubs: 4 open-concept living areas and 4 chef’s kitchens for massive group meals.

Guest access
Each property is equipped with a Yale smart lock—you’ll receive a personalized entry code in your check-in instructions prior to arrival. No keys to keep track of, and easy self check-in any time after 4 PM.

Other things to note
We’d love to host you, whether you’re visiting for a single night, a month, or even up to six months. At BetterBNB, our mission is to provide a clean, comfortable, and welcoming home where every guest feels cared for.

Your safety and comfort are our top priorities. We take pride in creating a space where you can relax, recharge, and feel at ease during your time in Nashville. Thank you for trusting us with your stay—we look forward to making your experience smooth, stress-free, and memorable.
